scope.surface: Sidebar V2 thread cards and active status

productLoss: The shared Sidebar group already supplied its content inset, but Lynx subtracted another 16px from the thread-list width.
At a 256px Sidebar the list and cards started at x=7 but ended at x=232, producing approximately 7px left and 24px right margins.
confirmedCorrectBehavior: Working is not a hard-coded session-independent state. SidebarV2.lynx calls resolveSidebarV2Status(thread), which delegates to shared deriveSidebarImmediateStatus.
The shared projection emits Working only when thread.session.status is running after pending approvals and pending user input have been given higher priority.
The exact Native run observes sessionStatus=running, workingExpected=true, and visible text Working.
harnessMismatch: The previous Sidebar geometry verifier only rejected overflow; it did not compare left/right insets or row/card widths to the list width.
The previous contract checked that the Working label existed in source but did not prove it agreed with the current session projection.
classification.evidenceBoundary: This exact-bundle run proves Native Sidebar/list/card geometry, active session-to-label causality, main transport, zero renderer errors, and cleanup. It does not claim a fresh matched pixel score.

validation.build: Lynx production build passed with existing unsupported-property and Effect import.meta warnings
validation.retainedTrialApp: PID 18721 remained alive throughout the run

remainingRisk: Working elapsed-duration rendering is not present in the Lynx status presentation and remains outside this checkpoint.
Fresh Web/Lynx pixel material parity was not recaptured.
Other Sidebar states such as approval, input, connecting, failed, and ready retain shared unit coverage but were not all exercised in this Native fixture.
